Messages.Author: beslin igor
Messages.Body:
Arika
Camarilla Ventrue Inner Circle: If Arika is ready during your prey's unlock phase, your prey chooses which locations he or she keeps in play. For each location he or she controls, your prey burns 1 pool or burns the location. +2 bleed.

Can Arika prey chose to gain benefits (Blood from Hunting Ground example) from locations if chose to burn this location?

Messages.Author: ResurrectioN
Messages.Body:
Yes.

The acting player gets to choose order in which he resolves everything in his unlock phase.

> Joscha wrote:
> Related question:
> Can Arika's special be forgotten?
> I guess not, as it is not a may clause.

No, it cannot be forgotten.

Any "if A is valid during X, do Y" clauses have to be resolved.
Take "Anarch Revolt" as the maybe most prominent example:
>
> Name: Anarch Revolt
> Cardtype: Master
> Master.
> Put this card in play. A Methuselah who does not control a ready anarch burns 1 pool during his or her unlock phase.

My predator has ready Arika, I control Elder Library and I have played

Do I have to draw to replace the wake or can i choose not to do it since my hand size has been reduced by one?

Cardtype: Master
Cost: 1 pool
Master: unique location.
+1 hand size.

Messages.Author: kschaefer
Messages.Body:
> Rémi wrote:
> My predator has ready Arika, I control Elder Library and I have played
> Wake with evening freshness during my predator s turn.
> If i don't pay for arika s hability, Elder Library is burn.
>
> Do I have to draw to replace the wake or can i choose not to do it since my hand size has been reduced by one?
>
At the start of your unlock phase, your hand size is 7 because it is 7 normally + 1 for EL - 1 for WWEF DNR clause. If you do not pay for the Elder Library, it burns, leaving you with a hand size of 6 (7 normal - 1 for WWEF DNR). You must then discard a card immediately before addressing any other effects. Once that is complete, you can then redraw the Wake.

Basically, it doesn't matter what order you draw a card to replace the Wake and burn the Elder Library to Arika's special, you will still have to discard a card.

Wrong.
You replace the Wake before the unlock phase starts (see www.vekn.net/forum/rules-questions/78701-replace-during-unlock-and-other-unlock-effects).
You have a hand size of 8 cards when your unlock phase starts.
Then if the Elder Library burns, you have to discard a card.
